turns.content: For water rotating about the HOH-angle bisector through oxygen, identify each atom's perpendicular distance contribution to the moment of inertia.
Use the 95.7 pm bond length and the available molecular geometry to find a perpendicular radius.
Explain why the angle-bisector axis also passes through the molecular centre of mass and why the oxygen contribution is zero.
Write the symbolic moment of inertia about this axis using the geometric conclusions and relevant masses established above.
Check the geometry by projecting both identical O-H bonds perpendicular to the axis and verify the factor of two.
Evaluate I using the parameter values established above and explain which atomic terms enter numerically.
Report I in kg m^2 to three significant figures and identify the contributing atoms.
